title: Mass of an integer multiplicity cycle supported in a plane near a point of density k
statement: For all P, n, k ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) that is integer multiplicity with ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T), every n-dimensional linear subspace Q of ℝ^P, every p ∈ Q and every r > 0 with B_r(p) ⊆ U and spt T ∩ B_r(p) ⊆ Q: if Θⁿ(μ_T, p) = k (HasMassDensity T p k), then M_W(T) = k·Hⁿ(W ∩ Q) for every open W ⊆ B_r(p), where Hⁿ := μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → BoundaryVanishes T → Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → p ∈ Q → 0 < r → ball p r ⊆ U → T.support ∩ ball p r ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P)) → HasMassDensity T p k → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ ball p r → T.massOn W = (k : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[n] (W ∩ (Q : Set (Euclid P)))
